rites.name: Ryila
rites.text: Ryila is the concept of a quiet, sleeping power in the Grounded Realm of Crare, bound to the early Seeding when the makers plant the Weave. It is less a being than a pattern of stillness that wakes only when the planted threads are first pulled taut.

rites.name: Gragun
rites.text: Gragun is a concept in the universe of Crare, born in the age after the Fall, when the Sundering split the land into Shards and the Pact was sworn among the survivors. It stands as an emblem of the grounded powers that held the broken fragments together, a idea that people invoked when rebuilding the shattered terrain. It is remembered less as a force than as a promise kept.

rites.name: Isiazora
rites.text: Isiazora is a concept in Crare's history, the idea of a tide of ordered flame that the orders of the Holy Age used to bind their temples to the Pact. Scribes say it was named in the Fall, when it was felt as a shared heat rather than a force that could be measured.

rites.name: Thanoldon
rites.text: Thanoldon is a concept of Crare's Walled Age, a body of belief and practice that grew around the holding walls, the orders that kept them, and the first crossings made over broken ground. It took its shape in the Age of the first sovereign, when groves were planted and young kingdoms staked their claims on tended land.

rites.name: Zephithora
rites.text: Zephithora is a concept in the universe of Crare, belonging to the Walled Age, when holding walls, orders, and churches shaped daily life. Its place in the Holy Age is tied to flame, temples, and the orders that kept the lamps lit. It is described as a shared idea rather than a single body or object, carried by those who rebuilt the walls after each winter.

rites.name: Cistelanum
rites.text: A stationed ability that releases disruptive surges of charged energy onto a chosen foe. Each surge strips away its protective barrier and freezes it in place for a short while.

rites.name: Tianteornor
rites.text: A tactical call-in that summons ordinary soldiers to hold a site or pin down hostile units. It must first be taught at the garrison, and it grows stronger across three stages.

rites.name: Valenaurnus
rites.text: A soldier's standing grows as it gains experience from defeating foes and seizing relay posts. Higher standing boosts its toughness and striking power, and unlocks special gear.

rites.name: Oronialium
rites.text: Each bearer carries a four-segment vitality tally wrapped in a pale outer aegis. The aegis soaks incoming harm, thins under strain, and slowly mends when the bearer is left unmolested.

rites.name: Thernunar
rites.text: Thernunar is a sanctioned collapse of a region's command grid, invoked when a faltering force decides to blind its foes' relays with a directed pulse. The surge scrambles every enhancement an opposing node carries, leaving the hardware standing but hollow in the tally of ground won.
